Write a Python function that parses an RFC5424 syslog line (PRI, version, timestamp, host, app, procid, msgid, message) and returns a dict
output:
import re

PATTERN = re.compile(r"^<(?P<pri>\d+)>(?P<version>\d+) (?P<ts>\S+) (?P<host>\S+) (?P<app>\S+) (?P<procid>\S+) (?P<msgid>\S+) (?P<rest>.*)$")

def parse_rfc5424(line):
    m = PATTERN.match(line)
    if not m:
        return None
    d = m.groupdict()
    d["pri"] = int(d["pri"])
    d["severity"] = d["pri"] % 8
    d["facility"] = d["pri"] // 8
    return d
